designBrief: Playful, community-warm cafe at Sunset Way, Singapore. Palette pulled from the business's own real photography and logo (warm cream, charcoal ink matching the logo's black linework, coral, leaf green for their in-store plant partnership, marigold as a sparing highlight). Fredoka (rounded, friendly) for headings, Nunito Sans for body — matching a real voice sample that is warm, emoji-forward and pun-loving. Single-page, photography-led, more visual energy than a minimal template. Signature element: an abstracted paw-print motif, referencing the real hand-drawn dog-and-cat mascot pair painted on the storefront signage, used as a section-divider and list-marker device.
